svg.text: Six crystal structures with explicit particle counts
AQA A-level crystal examples; counts are for each explicitly bounded representative drawing.
The dot count is the count in each schematic drawing; each is a slice or representative cluster, not a complete unit cell.
Network fragment: 6 C atoms; each extends in 3D
Two sheets: 6 C per sheet (12 C shown)
Cluster: 3 H₂O molecules linked by H-bonds
